bias.en: Bearish · closed below the September lows
bias.zh: 偏空 · 收盘跌破 9月低点

read.en: Teradyne fell 5.3% on Oct 16 to $325.00, near the day's low of $324.09, and is down 19% in five sessions. It is below the 5-day ($358.4), 10-day ($388.0), 30-day ($383.2) and 100-day ($381.5) averages and the rising 200-day ($344.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($424.39), and RSI is 33.
read.zh: 泰瑞达 10月16日下跌 5.3%，收于 $325.00，接近当日低点 $324.09，五个交易日累计下跌 19%。股价位于 5 日（$358.4）、10 日（$388.0）、30 日（$383.2）和 100 日均线（$381.5）以及上行的 200 日均线（$344.7）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方，抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$424.39），RSI 为 33。

read.en: The $331.9 Oct 15 low and the $326 September lows both broke and are now resistance, then $345 (200-day average, Oct 15 high) and $358 (5-day). Support is $309.4 (May 19 low), then $297–301 (late-July lows). A close below $309 would open $297–301; a close back above $332 would target $345.
read.zh: 10月15日低点 $331.9 和 9月低点 $326 均告失守，现转为阻力，其次 $345（200 日均线、10月15日高点）和 $358（5 日均线）。支撑为 $309.4（5月19日低点），其次 $297–301（7月下旬低点）。若收盘跌破 $309，下一目标看 $297–301；若收盘重回 $332 上方，目标看 $345。

r.en: September lows ($326–326.4) and Oct 15 low $331.9, now resistance
